line.en: A how-to as a stack of ruled index cards on linen: one step to a card, a two-colour line drawing, flicked away to show the next.
line.zh-CN: 亚麻桌布上的一叠横线索引卡讲步骤：一卡一步、双色线描，抽走一张露出下一张。

for.en: Short how-tos in three to six steps: cooking, gardening, crafts, home fixes, setting something up; with tips and a right-and-wrong way along the way.
for.zh-CN: 三到六步的简短教程：烹饪、园艺、手工、居家修理、设置某样东西；中间可以插入小贴士和对错示范。

not.en: Data, arguments and stories; steps that need real footage or a screen to follow. More than six steps.
not.zh-CN: 数据、论证和故事；必须看真实影像或屏幕才能跟上的步骤。超过六步的流程。
